ice-sell.title: Ice mined where a bid stands; with strict classes on each run gives its ice to Trade's receiver instead of selling (P5)
ice-sell.note: 2026-11-22 03:40 UTC (Zero), orders ENT-061 P5: the drains and carries of stored null matter, methane and ice left this template (sales are Trade's); the miners' stores go to Trade's and Logistics' receivers by the give-miner-stores-<station> routes of the list First once strict classes are on.
